title: Summonses Issued to Persons Who Feed Pigeons
what_it_is: Summonses Issued to Persons Who Feed Pigeons

sections.label: Pigeon feeding enforcement notices
sections.summary: 682 enforcement notices were issued for pigeon feeding over three years, and NParks uses cameras and surveillance at feeding hotspots.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, 682 enforcement notices were issued for pigeon feeding offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The National Parks Board (NParks) takes measures to deter the feeding of pigeons, including installing cameras and conducting surveillance at identified feeding hotspots.

sections.label: Pigeon feeding penalties
sections.summary: Pigeon feeders can currently be fined up to $500 per offence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the second point about increasing penalties, currently, pigeon feeders can be fined up to $500 per offence.

sections.label: Yio Chu Kang pilot results
sections.summary: Initial results from the high-rise littering and pigeon feeding pilot in Yio Chu Kang have been quite promising.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But also, I guess it is really about house-to-house visits for affected blocks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I would say that the initial results from this high-rise littering/pigeon feeding pilot in Yio Chu Kang have been quite promising.

sections.label: Nationwide rollout and culling
sections.summary: The speaker hopes to roll out the pilot nationwide, will discuss it with NParks, and notes culling is done at Town Council level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, I am really hopeful that this pilot that the Senior Parliamentary Secretary has mentioned, we can roll out nationwide so that we can now effectively tackle this problem.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I will take that back to my Ministry and I will also talk to NParks about it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We will see, where possible, how we can work towards achieving the outcome that we want, whether or not it is increasing more manpower or better use of the existing manpower that we have.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the point that the Member mentioned about culling, currently, population control measures are undertaken at the Town Council level.

sections.label: Contraceptives and other measures
sections.summary: Various other measures, including contraceptives, are being looked into and tried out.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The Member has talked about the use of contraceptives before.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, there are various other measures that we are looking into, things that we are trying out.
